category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, use z**0.75 instead of sqrt(z) for normalized training log-frequency, testing gentler attenuation of moderately frequent history items. Unseen-item features remain zero. The existing checkpoint buffer preserves predictor consistency without changing embeddings, topology, readout, loss or optimizer.

response.change_summary: Change the training-frequency feature exponent from 0.5 to 0.75 for all four category models; retain attenuation 1-0.3*feature and checkpoint-backed inference.
